description:
`after_commit/3` doc says failures use the error policy and `directive_timeout`. Code never calls the policy, uses `commit_timeout`, and logs nothing, so `last_effect_outcome` is the only signal. Decide whether to change the code or only the doc.

Owner: `jido.plugin`
Root cause: `lib/jido/plugin.ex:96-99`; `agent_server.ex:2585-2588,3172-3173,3263`
Claims: plugins.D1, plugins.D2
Repro (probe file: id prefix): `30_c_plugins`: `plugins.D1`, `plugins.D2`
Guides: none, the guide is already correct

Done when: The doc and code agree on timeout and error policy, and a failed hook is observable beyond last_effect_outcome.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B26. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.
